Preflight findings

Sequence inside [+script] sections. “Declared” means present in the image manifest, not proven reachable or executable on a target.

Explicit image entries, including source locations. Implicit libraries, directory expansion and SDK search results are not inferred.

Pin the current scan, edit or load another revision, then compare by rule, source file and message. Line-only changes do not count as new findings.

◎
A preflight, with a clear boundary.

BootLens checks a documented subset of mkifs configuration. It does not build an IFS, run QNX, inspect ELF dependencies, or prove that an image will boot. Missing includes and unresolved variables appear as analysis boundaries. Confirm every reviewed image with the licensed QNX toolchain and target tests.
